description: Getsemaní Colonial House is a vetted ALMAR private stay in Casa Centro Getsemaní, curated for international guests who want hotel-level discretion with the space and privacy of a residence.
Layout: 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 5 double beds, hosting up to 10 guests.
Property highlights include Private pool, rooftop terrace, living room, dining room.

fields.body: A private journey framework shaped around your dates, group, and confirmed availability. Stays, transfers, guides, dining, and experiences are proposed after inquiry and confirmed before booking.

fields.summary: Your first evening in Colombia at a private Cartagena villa. A personal chef crafts a seasonal menu from Caribbean harvests, served as the sun dissolves into the sea.
